description: Test suite for the TUI submit handler and related components, including behavior of command handling, message processing, burst coalescing, and environment detection.

methods.name: createSubmitHarness
methods.description: Creates a test harness for submitting messages and commands within the TUI submit handler tests.

methods.name: createSubmitBurstCoalescer
methods.description: Creates a function that coalesces rapid single-line submits into a multiline submit when enabled.

methods.name: shouldEnableWindowsGitBashPasteFallback
methods.description: Detects environment conditions under which Windows Git Bash paste fallback should be enabled.
